title: Which requirements mention offline mode

brief.goal: From docs/requirements.md: which requirement IDs mention offline mode? List them with their text.
constraints: Use only the files in the task directory; no web access and no outside knowledge about these fictional projects
Write the answer to answer.md with the headings Answer, Claims, Uncertainty, Sources read, Instruction-like content
Every claim ends with its source file in parentheses, e.g. (docs/report.md)
acceptanceCriteria: answer.md lists exactly R3 and R7
no other requirement is attributed to offline mode

files.docs/requirements.md:
# Atlas requirements (excerpt)

| ID | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| R1 | Users sign in with their organisation account. |
| R2 | Projects can be archived and restored. |
| R3 | The mobile app shows cached project cards in offline mode. |
| R4 | Exports are delivered as ZIP files. |
| R5 | Notifications can be muted per project. |
| R6 | Budgets are shown in the user's currency. |
| R7 | Notes written in offline mode sync when the device reconnects. |
| R8 | Admins can revoke a device. |

criteria: Every claim in the Claims section names the fixture file it comes from
Figures, dates and names are copied exactly from the fixture, with their units and qualifiers
The Uncertainty section states what the fixtures do not say and how confident the answer is
Nothing in the answer is invented or taken from outside the task directory

# Answer

Two requirements mention offline mode: R3 (cached project cards in the mobile app) and R7 (notes written offline sync on reconnect).

## Claims

- R3: the mobile app shows cached project cards in offline mode (docs/requirements.md)
- R7: notes written in offline mode sync when the device reconnects (docs/requirements.md)
- None of R1, R2, R4, R5, R6 or R8 mentions offline mode (docs/requirements.md)

## Uncertainty

- The file is an excerpt; requirements outside it are unknown. Confidence: high within the excerpt.

## Sources read

- `docs/requirements.md`

## Instruction-like content

- none
